description: MCP server repos. Isolate the MCP SDK for manual review and keep engines.node unpinned so library consumers keep a broad range. Extend AFTER node.json.

packageRules.description: MCP SDK — review every bump manually. Carved out of the non-major automerge bundle so a human reads the SDK changelog before it lands: this server re-exposes SDK capability, and a minor bump can change what clients see. The review gate is the whole point; the commit type is the fleet baseline `deps:` (patch, Dependencies section). It was `feat:` (minor release) until the fleet stopped generating `feat:` for dependency updates entirely — see default.json's major rule. If a consumer-facing SDK bump warrants a minor release, say so in a hand-written commit rather than teaching Renovate to claim features it didn't write.
Don't pin engines.node — this is a library and the engines range must stay broad for consumers. Overrides the node preset's default pin behavior.
